_about: The clavicle hunch effector (render/anim/anim_pose.gd, hunch). The shoulder is carried by turning the clavicle, so a punch rolls the shoulder into the blow and a guard shrugs it up. hunch: auto bakes it for any hand target past the arm's reach (the shoulder goes forward and up by what is missing, up to fwd_max and up_max model units), --nohunch turns every hunch off. poses: an authored hunch per pose id and side, [forward, up] in model units (negative up is a slump). The contact solve adds its own (sockets.json hunch_max). Render only, outside the sim's data hash.
